name: Seevetal (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and green with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Seevetal (a yellow lion, a wavy bar and a wheel on green).
history: Municipal flag of Seevetal; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Seevetal arms — lion, wavy bar and wheel on green
